verdict.rationale: Claude Projects create self-contained workspaces with their own knowledge bases and chat histories, and project files persist across conversations. Skills let users teach Claude repeatable task behaviors. Together these cover the 'own knowledge' and part of the 'own instructions' elements, but none of the evidence shows assistants being shared. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-project custom instructions, any evidence of sharing custom assistants or projects with others, independent or hands-on corroboration.
